entry: First numeric reporting observation on a UTC date strictly later than the supporting-publication eligibility bound. Exact-date FX required; never advance entry to repair missing FX.
exit: Fixed 1/5/20 subsequent numeric reporting observations; a 10% loss review exits at that observed reference, not an invented stop price. No intraday fill.
calendar: Actual EIA/Fed numeric reporting dates. Blank/ND are unavailable observations, not classified as holidays. No verified exchange-product calendar or executable quote is supplied.
cost_scope: Declared illustrative sensitivities, not a quoted broker tariff. Half full spread plus slippage each leg; fixed GBP fee each leg reserved inside the allocation; exact-date GBP conversion. No leverage, shorts, interest or tax; dividends/roll/yield unavailable, so security/derivative execution is unsupported.
universe: All 51 retained events and every explicitly targeted instrument. Missing asset histories and failed windows remain in the denominator. No invented IPO allocation or opening fill.
selection: Nine predefined rule/horizon combinations; all four cost scenarios, winners and losers reported. No optimization or winner ranking in SIM-1.
allocation_scope: The allocation includes entry fees and a reserved exit fee; no leverage and no greater than 10% of cash.
currency_exposure: GBP/USD hypotheses hold unleveraged USD cash funded from GBP, valued at reciprocal USD per GBP. Oil-linked GBP/USD conversion references never become independent FX signals.
